     the full year 2020 of RMB535.0 million, representing no less than 30% of     人民幣535.0百萬元，不低於年度可分配淨利
     our net annual distributable profits of approximately RMB1.7 billion, as a   潤約人民幣17億元的30%，作為對股東支持
     return to the supports of our shareholders.                                  的回報。

Case:       Carry out Nine Environmental Protection “Ultra-low Emission” Control Projects to Facilitate the Battle for Blue Sky
案例：       九大環保「超超低排放」治理項目助力藍天保衛戰


         In 2020, the Group’s Xingtai Production Base implemented nine new environmental protection transformation
         projects, including the three-in-one desulfurization and ultra-low emission transformation project, the ultra-
         low and in-depth treatment of the coke oven flue gas project, the coke oven riser waste heat instead of tube
         furnace project, the SNCR denitrification project of the flue gas of the methanol integrated heating furnace,
         and other projects. The completion and commissioning of the nine environmental protection “ultra-low
         emission” upgrading and transformation projects is another significant breakthrough achieved by Xingtai
         Production Base in environmental protection management on the basis of the original achievement of “ultra-
         low emission”. After treatment by the new device, the emission indicators of various pollution factors in Xingtai
         Production Base have fully achieved the “ultra-low emission” standard, among which sulfur dioxide emission
         concentration was less than or equal to 10 mg/m3, and nitrogen oxide emission concentration was less than
         or equal to 30 mg/m3. The pollutant emissions can be reduced by 218 tons per year on the existing basis. The
         nine environmental protection transformation projects implemented by the Group’s Xingtai Production Base
         have played an active role in demonstrating and leading the Battle for Blue Sky.
         2020年，本集團邢台生產園區新實施了九大環保改造項目，包括三合一脫硫超超低排放改造項目、焦爐煙氣超
         超低深度治理項目、焦爐上升管餘熱替代管式爐項目、甲醇綜合加熱爐煙氣SNCR脫硝項目等項目。九大環保
        「超超低排放」升級改造項目的全部竣工投用，是邢台生產園區在原本已達到「超低排放」的基礎上，在環保治理方
         面再次取得的重大突破。經過新裝置處理後，邢台生產園區的各項污染因子排放指標已完全實現「超超低排放」標
         準，其中二氧化硫排放濃度≤10毫克╱立方米，氮氧化物排放濃度≤30毫克╱立方米，每年可在現有基礎上再減
         少污染物排放218噸。本集團邢台生產園區實施的九大環保改造項目在地方藍天保衛戰中發揮了積極的示範引領
         作用。

                          Implement Seven Environmental Protection and In-depth Treatment Projects in Dingzhou Production Base
              Case:
                         to Promote Cleaner Production
            案例：
                        定州生產園區實施七大環保深度治理項目推動清潔生產


                       During the reporting period, seven environmental protection and in-depth treatment projects implemented in
                       the Group’s Dingzhou Production Base, including the advanced sewage treatment, full closure of coal yards,
                       smoke plume elimination, and VOC treatment, were all completed and put into use, further improving the level
                       of cleaner production in the Dingzhou Production Base, and providing assistance to continuous development.
                       After the projects were put into use, the emission of particulate matter can be reduced by 355 tons, the

4.   SIGNIFICANT ACCOUNTING POLICIES                                             4.   主要會計政策

     The consolidated financial statements has been prepared in                       綜合財務報表乃根據國際會計準則理
     accordance with IFRSs issued by IASB. For the purpose of                         事會頒佈的國際財務報告準則編製。
     preparation of the consolidated financial statements, information                就編製綜合財務報表之目的而言，當
     is considered material if such information is reasonably expected                可合理預期該等資料會影響主要使用
     to influence decisions made by primary users. In addition, the                   者之決策，該等資料則被視為屬重
     consolidated financial statements includes applicable disclosures                大。此外，綜合財務報表包括聯交所
     required by the Rules Governing the Listing of Securities on the                 證券上市規則及香港公司條例規定的
     Stock Exchange and by the Hong Kong Companies Ordinance.                         適用披露。

     The consolidated financial statements has been prepared on the                   綜合財務報表乃按歷史成本基準編
     historical cost basis except for certain financial instruments that              製，惟若干金融工具如下文載列的會
     are measured at fair values at the end of each reporting period, as              計政策所述於各報告期末以公允值計
     explained in the accounting policies below.                                      量除外。

     Historical cost is generally based on the fair value of the                      歷史成本通常基於換取商品及服務交
     consideration given in exchange for goods and services.                          易所付出代價的公允值。

     Fair value is the price that would be received to sell an asset or                公允值是於計量日期由市場參與者於
     paid to transfer a liability in an orderly transaction between market             有秩序交易中出售資產可收取或轉讓
     participants at the measurement date, regardless of whether that                  負債須支付的價格，而不論該價格是
     price is directly observable or estimated using another valuation                 否直接可觀察或可使用其他估值技術
     technique. In estimating the fair value of an asset or a liability,               估計。若市場參與者於計量日期對資
     the Group takes into account the characteristics of the asset or                  產或負債定價時會考慮資產或負債的
     liability if market participants would take those characteristics into            特點，則本集團於估計資產或負債的
     account when pricing the asset or liability at the measurement                    公允值時會考慮該等特點。綜合財務
     date. Fair value for measurement and/or disclosure purposes in                    報表中作計量及╱或披露用途的公允
     the consolidated financial statements is determined on such a                     值乃按此基準釐定，惟根據國際財務
     basis, except for leasing transactions that are accounted for in                  報告準則第16號入賬的租賃交易，以
     accordance with IFRS 16, and measurements that have some                          及與公允值有部分相若地方但並非公
     similarities to fair value but are not fair value, such as net realizable         允值的計量，譬如國際會計準則第2號
     value in IAS 2 Inventories or value in use in IAS 36 Impairment of               「存貨」內的可變現淨值或國際會計準則
     Assets.                                                                           第36號「資產減值」的使用價值除外。

     A fair value measurement of a non-financial asset takes into account             非金融資產的公允值計量須計及一名
     a market participant’s ability to generate economic benefits by                  市場參與者透過使用其資產的最高及
     using the asset in its highest and best use or by selling it to another          最佳用途或透過將資產出售予將使用
     market participant that would use the asset in its highest and best              其最高及最佳用途的另一名市場參與
     use.                                                                             者而能夠產生經濟利益的能力。

     For financial instruments which are transferred at fair value and                按公允值轉讓的金融工具，凡於其後
     a valuation technique that unobservable inputs is to be used to                  期間應用以不可觀察輸入數據計量公

     the customers.

     A performance obligation represents a good or service (or a bundle              履約責任指一個明確貨品或服務（或一
     of goods or services) that is distinct or a series of distinct goods or         批明確貨品或服務）或一系列大致相同

     time by reference to the progress towards complete satisfaction of              按時間轉移，而收益則參考完全履行
     the relevant performance obligation if one of the following criteria is         相關履約責任的進度按時間確認：
     met:

     •     the customer simultaneously receives and consumes the                     •    於本集團履約時，客戶同時取得
           benefits provided by the Group’s performance as the Group                      並耗用實體履約所提供的利益；
           performs;

           the customer controls as the Group performs; or                                產，而該項資產於本集團履約時
                                                                                          由客戶控制；或

     •     the Group’s performance does not create an asset with                     •    本集團的履約並未創造讓本集團
           an alternative use to the Group and the Group has an                           有替代用途的資產，且本集團對
           enforceable right to payment for performance completed to                      迄今已完成履約的付款具有可強
           date.                                                                          制執行的權利。

     Otherwise, revenue is recognized at a point in time when the                    否則，收益於客戶獲得商品或服務的
     customer obtains control of the goods or services.                              控制權的時點確認。

               Lease                                                                         租賃

               Definition of a lease                                                         租賃的定義

               A contract is, or contains, a lease if the contract conveys the right         倘合約給予權利在一段時間內使用已
               to control the use of an identified asset for a period of time in             識別資產以換取代價，則該合約為或

               assesses whether a contract is or contains a lease based on the               本集團於開始或修訂日期根據於國際

               contract will not be reassessed unless the terms and conditions of            合約是否為或包含租賃。該合約將不
               the contract are subsequently changed.                                        會被重新評估，除非該合約中的條款
                                                                                             與條件隨後被改動。

               The Group as a lessee                                                         本集團作為承租人

               of the relative stand-alone price of the lease component and the              獨立價格及非租賃組成部分的獨立價

                                                                                             部分。

               The Group applies practical expedient not to separate non-lease               本集團亦採用實際權宜方法，不將非
               components from lease component, and instead account for the                  租賃組成部分與租賃組成部分分開，
               lease component and any associated non-lease components as a                  反而將租賃組成部分及任何相關非租
               single lease component.                                                       賃組成部分入賬列為單一租賃組成部

     Group expects, at the end of each reporting period, to recover or               付資產及負債賬面值可能引致的稅務
     settle the carrying amounts of its assets and liabilities.                      後果。

     For the purposes of measuring deferred tax for leasing transactions             就計量本集團確認使用權資產及相關
     in which the Group recognizes the right-of-use assets and the                   租賃負債的租賃交易的遞延稅項而
     related lease liabilities, the Group first determines whether the tax           言，本集團首先釐定稅項扣減是否歸

     liabilities.

     For leasing transactions in which the tax deductions are attributable           就租賃負債應佔稅項扣減的租賃交易
     to the lease liabilities, the Group applies IAS 12 Income Taxes                 而言，本集團對使用權資產及租賃負
     requirements to right-of-use assets and lease liabilities separately.           債分別應用國際會計準則第12號「所得

     liabilities are not recognized at initial recognition and over the lease        使用權資產及租賃負債有關之暫時性
     terms due to application of the initial recognition exemption.                  差額並未於初始確認時及於租賃期內
                                                                                     確認。

     Deferred tax assets and liabilities are offset when there is a legally          如有法定可執行權利將即期稅項資產

     liabilities and when they relate to income taxes levied to the same             及負債與同一稅務部門向同一課稅實

     Current and deferred tax are recognized in profit or loss, except               即期及遞延稅項於損益中確認，惟與

     the initial accounting for a business combination, the tax effect is            行初始會計處理而產生即期稅項或遞

     Financial instruments                                                               金融工具

     Financial assets and financial liabilities are recognized when a                    當集團實體成為工具合約條文之訂約
     group entity becomes a party to the contractual provisions of the                   方，則會確認金融資產及金融負債。
     instrument. All regular way purchases or sales of financial assets                  所有常規金融資產買賣均按交易日期
     are recognized and derecognized on a trade day basis. Regular                       基準確認及終止確認。常規買賣為須
     way purchases or sales are purchases or sales of financial assets                   按市場規管或慣例確立之時限內交付

               Definition of default                                                         違約的定義

               For internal credit risk management, the Group considers an event             就內部信貸風險管理而言，當內部產
               of default occurs when information developed internally or obtained           生或獲取自外部來源的資料表明，債

               amounts due in accordance with the contractual terms.                         到期款項時，本集團認為構成違約事
                                                                                             件。

               Irrespective of the above, the Group considers that default has               無論上述情況如何，倘一項金融資產
               occurred when a financial asset is more than 90 days past due                 已逾期超過90日，則本集團認為已產
               unless the Group has reasonable and supportable information                   生違約，除非本集團有合理及可靠資
               to demonstrate that a more lagging default criterion is more                  料證明較寬鬆的違約標準更為適用則
               appropriate.                                                                  當別論。

               that financial asset have occurred. Evidence that a financial asset           時，即代表金融資產已出現信貸減
               is credit-impaired includes observable data about the following               值。金融資產出現信貸減值的證據包
               events:                                                                       括涉及以下事件的可觀察數據。

               •      significant financial difficulty of the issuer or the borrower;        •   發行方或借款人遇到嚴重財政困
                                                                                                 難；

                                                                                                 況；

                      reasons relating to the borrower’s financial difficulty, having            合約考慮，給予借款人在其他情
                      granted to the borrower a concession(s) that the lender(s)                 況下不會作出的讓步；

     has been placed under liquidation or has entered into bankruptcy                 集團會撇銷金融資產。已撇銷的金融

     Measurement and recognition of ECL                                               預期信貸虧損的計量及確認

     The measurement of ECL is a function of the probability of default,              預期信貸虧損的計量乃指違約概率、
     loss given default (i.e. the magnitude of the loss if there is a default)        違約損失率（即倘違約引致損失的程度）
     and the exposure at default. The assessment of the probability                   及達約風險的函數。評估違約概率及
     of default and loss given default is based on historical data and                違約損失率根據過往數據及前瞻性資
     forward-looking information. Estimation of ECL reflects an unbiased              料而作出。預期信貸虧損的估計反映
     and probability-weighted amount that is determined with the                      無偏頗及概率加權的數額，其乃，根
     respective risks of default occurring as the weights. The Group                  據加權的相應違約風險蘆定。本集團
     uses a practical expedient in estimating ECL on trade receivables                採用可行權宜方法，利用撥備矩陣估
     using a provision matrix taking into consideration historical credit             計貿易應收款項的預期信貸虧捐，當
     loss experience, adjusted for forward looking information that is                中計及過往信貸虧損經驗，並根據毋
     available without undue cost and effort.                                         須付出不必要努力即可獲得的前職性
                                                                                      資料進行調整。

     Generally, the ECL is estimated as the difference between all                    一般而言，預期信貸虧損估計為本集
     contractual cash flows that are due to the Group in accordance                   團根據合約應收的所有合約現金流量
     with the contract and all the cash flows that the Group expects to               與本集團預計收取的所有現金流量之
     receive, discounted at the effective interest rate determined at initial         間的差額，並按初始確認時釐定的實
     recognition.                                                                     際利率貼現。

     For a financial guarantee contract, the Group is required to make                就財務擔保合約而言，本集團須僅在
     payments only in the event of a default by the debtor in accordance              債務人違反保證文書條款的情況下作
     with the terms of the instrument that is guaranteed. Accordingly, the            出付款。因此，預期信貸虧損是償還
     ECL is the present value of the expected payments to reimburse                   持有人信貸損失的預期付款的現值，
     the holder for a credit loss that it incurs less any amounts that the            該信貸損失減去本集團預期從持有
     Group expects to receive from the holder, the debtors or any other               人、債務人或任何其他方獲得的任何
     party.                                                                           金額。

   be distributed, the Company will be in a position to pay off its debts           程中償還到期債務。
   as and when they fall due in the ordinary course of business.

   Merger reserve                                                                   合併儲備

   The merger reserve represents the difference between the                         合併儲備指本公司已發行股本面值與
   nominal value of the share capital issued by the Company and                     根據本集團重組所收購附屬公司合計
   the aggregate capital of the subsidiaries acquired pursuant to the               資本之間的差額，根據合併會計基準
   group reorganization, accounted for as capital contribution from                 作為最終控股公司的注資入賬。
   ultimate holding company under merger basis of accounting.

   Reserve fund                                                                     儲備基金

   The Articles of Association of certain PRC subsidiaries require the              若干中國附屬公司的組織章程細則要
   appropriation of 10% of their profit after tax each year, based on               求每年根據其法定經審核財務報表將
   their statutory audited financial statements, to the reserve fund until          其除稅後溢利的10%撥入儲備基金，
   the balance reaches 50% of the registered capital of the respective              直至結餘達到相應中國附屬公司註冊
   PRC subsidiaries. The reserve fund may be capitalized as the paid-               資本的50%。儲備基金可資本化為該
   in capital of these subsidiaries.                                                等附屬公司的實收資本。

38. CAPITAL MANAGEMENT                                                     38. 資本管理

   The Group’s primary objectives of managing capital are to                   本集團管理資本的主要目的是維護其
   safeguard the Group’s ability to continue as a going concern, and to        持續經營的能力，從而使其能夠透過
   provide returns for shareholders and benefits for other stakeholders,       按合理成本取得融資，繼續為股東提
   by securing access to finance at a reasonable cost.                         供回報及為其他持份者提供利益。

   The Group actively and regularly reviews and manages its capital            本集團積極及定期檢討和管理其資本
   structure to maintain a balance between the higher shareholder              架構，以在維持較高借款水平可能帶
   returns that might be possible with higher levels of borrowings, and        來的高股東回報取得平衡，並因應不
   makes adjustments to the capital structure in light of changes in           同的經濟狀況為資本架構作出調整。
   economic conditions.

   Based on recommendations of the board of directors, the Group will          根據董事會建議，本集團將透過調整
   balance its overall capital structure through adjusting the amount          向股東派付的股息金額、發行新股、
   of dividends paid to shareholders, issuing of new shares, raising           籌集新債務融資或出售資產以減少債
   new debt financing or selling assets to reduce debt. During the             務，藉以平衡其整體資本架構。於報
   reporting period, there were no changes in the objectives, policies         告期內，並無更改目標、政策或程
   or processes.                                                               序。

   The Group monitors capital with reference to its debt position. The         本集團透過參考其債務狀況監察資
   Group’s strategy was to maintain the equity and debt in a balanced          本。本集團的策略為將權益與債項維
   position and ensure there was adequate working capital to service           持在一個平衡的位置，並確保擁有足
   its debt obligation.                                                        夠的營運資金償還其債務。
